name: Screens Gate
description: WO-P5-17 — THE SCREENS GATE. A real installed mod that declares a screen. The screen renders in an isolated frame (sandbox="allow-scripts", no allow-same-origin — R1) with no access to the app's DOM, storage, or network. The screen source ships as text and the server never evaluates it (R2). A 5.1 screen is useless on purpose — it draws from its own code and stops (R6). Delete this file and the app still runs.
